name: Water Sapta
summary: At Islen Waterseer's shore, a young Horde shaman receives Water Sapta for a journey across the Great Sea. The trial leads from the Barrens to Silverpine Forest, where a spring has been corrupted.

sections.title: A Vision of Water
sections.body: Among Horde shaman, a sapta is a draught made to open the senses to the world's spirits. To ordinary eyes, a stream may look calm and a pond still. Drink a sapta, and the veil of the physical world parts, showing the elementals that dwell in the water.

sections.title: The Road to Silverpine
sections.body: Islen Waterseer gives the shaman the draught after they have shown their devotion to the spirits. She lives alone on the barren shore south of Ratchet. She sends the initiate across the Great Sea, away from Kalimdor's dry valleys, to Silverpine Forest. There, an elemental corruption is poisoning Lordaeron's streams, and the shaman must face it.

faq.answer: A sapta is a ceremonial draught prepared by shamanic mentors. Drinking it sharpens spiritual sight, so the shaman can see and speak with elementals hidden from mortal eyes.

Islen Waterseer is a master shaman who lives alone on the Barrens' eastern coast, south of the Merchant Coast. She guides young Horde shaman on the hard path to commune with and bind the element of water.

faq.q: Why must the shaman travel to Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Water's elementals are suffering from a widespread affliction in Silverpine Forest. To complete their initiation, shaman carry the sapta across the sea and see a corrupted water source firsthand, then cleanse its taint.

faq.q: What happens after drinking the sapta?
faq.answer: After drinking the sapta, shaman can see the corrupted water elementals in Silverpine's tainted pools. That sight opens the way to confront the source of the decay.

faq.q: Is this trial required for all Horde shaman?
faq.answer: Yes. Orc, tauren, and troll shaman all heed the Call of Water and receive the sapta as a rite of passage before earning their Water Totem.

faq.q: Where in Silverpine is the corrupted pool located?
faq.answer: The corrupted spring lies on Silverpine Forest's coast, west of the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As a shaman, you take a turning step in your elemental trials with the Water Sapta. It opens your eyes to the spirit world before you gain command of your healing Water Totem.
As a member of the Horde, you see this trial send initiates from Kalimdor's sun-bleached plains to Lordaeron's haunted woods.
